records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 were $107.5 million, as compared to $119.2 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continued to maintain our strong financial position, successfully managing our liquidity and our inventory levels, which were down 10.7% to October 28, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: While we continued to diligently manage our operating expenses, given the pressure on sales, some of our cost structure was negatively deleveraged by the sales shortfall.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically, and consistent with the retail industry, we have experienced seasonal fluctuations as it relates to our operating income, net income, and free cash flow.
